baseBehavior.evidence: Base full-scan algorithm, exercised against frozen request/response frames before production code change.

causalProtocol.baseRegression: FAIL on deterministic uncaptured irrelevant work count after exact frozen response checks; exit 101.
causalProtocol.repairRemoval: FAIL and repeated full-scan counts reappear when the candidate mechanism is bypassed; exact L-B semantic control still matches.
causalProtocol.restoredRepair: PASS with zero irrelevant snapshot inspections; L-A/L-B/L-C exact response envelopes match frozen production stdio.

classification: Relevant means the event completion ID is in the snapshot effective-descendant completion set, or the event ID is a raw descendant eligible to be excluded by evaluation limit. Irrelevant counters are cfg(test) classifications of inspections whose event has neither relation.

necessaryTransitions.completionAndFailure: Candidate relation keyed by effective completion IDs; failure state is evaluated in the unchanged capture finalizer on those transitions.
necessaryTransitions.controls: Focused and full Rust controls cover nested/forGroup completion, disabled/inactive/excluded/failed descendants, geometry value failures, early propagation, evaluation limits and semantic output.
necessaryTransitions.evaluationLimit: Raw descendant exclusion candidates are indexed; evaluation-limit exclusion is inserted before the same element completion event. Terminal finalization still uses the full-scan fallback.
necessaryTransitions.geometryValue: When geometry_value_program is nonempty, retain the original full scan because pending/failure transitions do not have the same simple completion-event owner.
necessaryTransitions.terminalAndEarlyStop: completion_event_id=None retains the original full scan for terminal completion and stop handling.

semanticComparison: All three L causal request/response envelopes match exact frozen production stdio responses; the final nine-cell matrix passes independent source-defined geometry and 32-chord oracle plus full Rust/TypeScript parity.
